query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.verification_label IS NULL THEN LENGTH(r.body) END)-AVG(CASE WHEN r.verification_label IS NOT NULL THEN LENGTH(r.body) END),1) FROM reviews r JOIN products p USING(category,ref_id) WHERE p.category='office products' AND p.status='active' AND r.body IS NOT NULL
columns: ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.verification_label IS NULL THEN LENGTH(r.body) END)-AVG(CASE WHEN r.verification_label IS NOT NULL THEN LENGTH(r.body) END),1)
